final: WITH per_group AS (SELECT s.zoneref, st.typesite, AVG(s.pressratio) AS avg_pressratio, AVG(s.gbsize / s.spanmin) AS avg_size_per_minute FROM scans AS s JOIN sites AS st ON st.zoneregistry = s.zoneref WHERE s.chronotag >= '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND s.chronotag <= '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY s.zoneref, st.typesite) SELECT AVG(avg_pressratio) AS avg_of_group_compression_averages, AVG(avg_size_per_minute) AS avg_of_group_size_per_minute_averages FROM per_group
